title: Sellfy Review (2026)
intro: Sellfy is evaluated here as ecommerce software for digital downloads and creator storefronts. Research-grounded editorial review as of 2026-08-23 — not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Shortlist Sellfy for digital goods; compare Shopify or Ecwid for broader ecommerce.
verdict: Shortlist Sellfy when a lightweight digital-goods storefront is the job. Compare Shopify when you need app ecosystem depth.
limitations: Confirm live plan limits on sellfy.com
whoShouldChoose: Creators and micro businesses selling digital products.
whoShouldConsiderAlternatives: Compare Shopify or Ecwid for broader ecommerce.

faq.question: Is Sellfy like Shopify?
faq.answer: Sellfy is digital-goods and creator oriented; Shopify is broader omnichannel ecommerce. Compare fit by catalogue depth and integrations.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Sellfy is an ecommerce platform for digital downloads, subscriptions, and creator storefronts.
